title: Quadcopter Drone CAD Assembly
summary: Open-source FreeCAD multi-rotor UAV airframe with dual octagonal plates, 4 cantilevered motor arms, 8 standoff fasteners, 4 outrunner motors, 4 dual-blade propellers, and 4 hub lock covers.

assemblySteps.title: Sandwich Octagonal Chassis Plates and Standoffs
assemblySteps.summary: Seat the eight standoff pins on the lower chassis plate and align the four motor arm roots.

assemblySteps.title: Lock Cantilevered Arms with Upper Plate
assemblySteps.summary: Insert all four cantilevered arms and secure the upper octagonal chassis plate.

assemblySteps.title: Seat Outrunner Brushless Motors
assemblySteps.summary: Mount each outrunner motor into the cylindrical boss at the distal tip of each arm.

assemblySteps.title: Install Propellers and Lock Nut Covers
assemblySteps.summary: Slide the four dual-blade propellers onto the shafts and cap each hub with a lock cover.

assemblySteps.title: Install Flight Stack, Receiver, and Battery Pack
assemblySteps.summary: Place the ESC on the upper plate and stack the flight controller above it. Seat the receiver behind the stack and secure the pack beneath the chassis.

assemblySteps.title: Wire Power Distribution and Motor Phase Harnesses
assemblySteps.summary: Connect battery power to the ESC, then attach the flight controller and receiver leads. Follow each arm to connect its three motor phases.
